top_stories.title: ‘Super corruption government’ is coming to exist: Chalavadi Narayanaswamy - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Chalavadi Narayanaswamy**, leader of the Opposition in the Legislative Council, criticized the **BJP** for its handling of the dissolved government, alleging that corruption persists despite the change. He stated that officers continue to engage in corrupt practices and development projects remain stalled, emphasizing the need for systemic changes rather than superficial leadership shifts.  Narayanaswamy also accused the Congress of neglecting Dalits and failing to nominate a Dalit as Chief Minister.

top_stories.title: Europe airport chaos: UK travellers asked to arrive 3 hours early as border checks cause delays - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Passengers** travelling between the UK and several European destinations are facing delays due to the **European Union's Entry Exit System (EES)**, a new border management scheme requiring biometric data from non-EU travellers.  The system, which has recorded nearly 80 million entries and exits, is causing significant congestion at airports, particularly in Spain, Portugal, and France. **Airlines**, including **Wizz Air**, are advising passengers to arrive at least three hours before departure, while **Airports Council International (ACI Europe)** has called for improvements to border staffing levels and technical systems. Despite the challenges, the **European Commission** maintains that the system is largely functioning as intended.

top_stories.title: WHO chief visits epicentre of Ebola outbreak in DR Congo - World - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus**, **World Health Organization’s** director general, visited the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to assess the Ebola outbreak response. The highly contagious haemorrhagic fever has already spread to three provinces in DRC and neighboring Uganda, with at least 1,077 suspected cases reported.  The WHO is working with the **DRC government** to address challenges and ensure community ownership of the response.  While a patient recovered from the outbreak on Wednesday, marking the first case discharged after two negative tests, medical experts are still insufficiently deployed to the region. The outbreak is occurring in an unstable area with limited laboratory capacity and ongoing conflict, raising concerns about its spread within displacement camps.

top_stories.title: Egypt warns Israel that dangerous Gaza escalations threaten ceasefire | Gaza News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Egypt** has launched an urgent diplomatic intervention to salvage a fragile Gaza ceasefire agreement that is on the brink of collapse. **Israel**'s recent military attacks and statements threatening to unravel months of diplomacy have pushed the deal to the edge.  The Egyptian government warned **Israel** against expanding its occupation in Gaza, while also inviting a senior Hamas delegation led by chief negotiator Khalil al-Hayya for urgent talks. The diplomatic moves come amid a surge in deadly air strikes that have killed at least 141 Palestinians in the last two weeks and an Israeli directive to expand control from 53% to 70%.  **Egypt** is coordinating with mediators in Qatar, Turkey, and the US to return the process to a negotiating track.

top_stories.title: KP CM Afridi urges GB chief justice to ensure transparency amid 'alarming' electoral environment - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chief Minister Sohail Afridi** urged the **Chief Justice of the Supreme Appellate Court of Gilgit-Baltistan** to intervene in upcoming elections due to reported incidents of harassment and restrictions on political activities.  Afridi cited the expulsion of PTI MNA Junaid Akbar and his team, as well as the alleged prevention of **Asad Qaiser**, a senior PTI leader, from reaching Islamabad airport, all during the campaign period. The CM emphasized constitutional guarantees for free and fair elections and called for swift action against any violations to ensure credible and transparent elections in Gilgit-Baltistan.

top_stories.title: The Iran war is dividing Muslims in the Philippines | US-Israel war on Iran | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: The US-Israeli war on Iran and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz have had a significant impact on Muslim communities in the Philippines, particularly in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region.  **Islamic scholars** are divided over the conflict, with some supporting Iran's retaliation against the United States and others opposing it due to its Shia nature. This division has deepened existing tensions between scholars and fueled polarizing narratives about Palestine and the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. The entanglement of politics and religion in this context is further complicated by external influences from Arab countries and a lack of unity among Muslim communities.  This situation poses challenges for community cohesion, critical thinking, and the pursuit of self-determination.

top_stories.title: Sajid Javid says backing Liz Truss to lead Tories was his ‘biggest political mistake’ | Sajid Javid | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Sajid Javid**, former chancellor, admitted his support for **Liz Truss** in the 2022 Conservative leadership contest was a "biggest mistake" in his political career. He stated that he no longer speaks with **Truss** and believes the quality of British politics has declined. He also argued for increased MP pay to attract high-caliber individuals, suggesting halving the number of MPs and doubling their salaries. Javid served as home secretary, chancellor, and health secretary under various prime ministers before resigning in 2022.  He is now a partner at Centricus, a private equity firm, and chair of the Holocaust Memorial Day Trust.

top_stories.title: Jupiter Wagons Q4 Results: Cons PAT tumbles 72% to Rs 29 crore, revenue falls 25% YoY - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Jupiter Wagons'** revenue from operations declined 25% year-over-year to Rs 780 crore in the latest quarter, while EBITDA dropped by 46% to Rs 83 crore. The company's expenses also decreased by 20%, but its profit after tax fell significantly to Rs 166 crore, down from Rs 380 crore in the previous year. **Jefferies** initiated coverage on Jupiter Wagons with an 'Underperform' rating and a target price of Rs 200, citing concerns about growth moderation due to dependence on the freight wagon segment.

top_stories.title: Meet ICE agent Christian Castro, arrested in Texas for shooting at a Venezuelan in Minneapolis and lying about it - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **ICE agent Christian Castro** has been arrested for shooting Julio Cesar Sosa-Celis, a Venezuelan migrant, during an incident in Minneapolis on January 14th. **Castro** initially claimed self-defense after a confrontation with Alfredo Aljorna, but surveillance footage contradicted his account.  The charges against both **Aljorna** and Sosa-Celis were dropped, and **ICE** officials are not supporting the state charges against **Castro**. The case is currently being handled at the federal level, with potential extradition proceedings to be determined by the states of Texas and Minnesota.
